owner_facing_goal: Add the 拳掌 (fist) school's weapon: a pair of dark-iron gauntlets in one item, worn on both hands, a diamond-tier CombatWeaponItem with fast, light attributes whose cultivation combat comes entirely from data (yuanxian:basic_fist: straight punch, horizontal palm, uppercut, chopping palm, step-in double strike), with mapped vanilla behavior in vanilla mode.

creative_tab.ordering: Immediately after yuanxian:lingxiao_spear and before the Baiqing gauntlet.

behavior.server_client_boundary: In vanilla mode the item follows the Minecraft SwordItem path; CombatWeaponItem only keeps a durability-only stack change from replaying the equip animation. In cultivation mode the combat runtime finds the item through data/yuanxian/combat/weapon/xuantie_gauntlet.json (family fist); no Java code names the item, and the server owns mode, move, timing, hit volume, targets, damage, step movement, recovery, and synchronization exactly as for other data-registered weapons.
behavior.interaction: Mapped vanilla left-click attack/mining outside cultivation mode; the five yuanxian:basic_fist moves inside it. No right-click behavior. Worn on the main hand, and as a pair (weapon file paired) mirrored on the off hand while the off-hand slot is empty: the third-person model sits over each fist, and in first person the off hand guards wearing the mirrored gauntlet.
behavior.cooldown_or_durability: Diamond-tier durability 1561 and max stack size 1 from the tier. Held attack damage 5.0 and attack speed 2.2 (SwordItem.createAttributes(Tiers.DIAMOND, 1, -1.8F)). Cultivation timing is move-owned by the style data.
data_components: No item-owned combo or mode component
tests: Registration as CombatWeaponItem, attributes, creative-tab ordering, bilingual names, and swords-tag membership match this contract (tools/validate_mod_items.py)
The item model is a neoforge:separate_transforms wrapper over yuanxian:item/xuantie_gauntlet_3d whose gui perspective stays the 2D yuanxian:item/xuantie_gauntlet icon
No Java source under combat/** or client/combat/** names the item

jar_checks: item.yuanxian.xuantie_gauntlet is present in assets/yuanxian/lang/en_us.json and assets/yuanxian/lang/zh_cn.json

non_goals: Crafting recipe, loot acquisition, natural generation, or advancement hook
Any Java hook that names the item outside ModItems
A separate left-hand item or slot logic: the left gauntlet is presentation only and never touches the off-hand slot
School-specific runtime behaviour from the weapon family (data only for now)
New sound assets, projectiles, special arts, or spiritual-power cost
